payload.reason: The evidence clearly states that the proposed multimodal NER (MNER) model incorporates both text and images for named entity recognition, demonstrating the integration of visual information with textual data.

claims.text: The MNER model learns NER from both text and images by integrating visual context with textual information.
The modality attention module in the MNER model selectively amplifies relevant visual contexts while processing text, enhancing NER performance.
